description: Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources - Departure and Arrival of Mechanized Fishing Boats Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996. It establishes new regulatory requirements for the departure and arrival of mechanized fishing boats, including permit applications, conditions, and enforcement provisions. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it creates new subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks under an existing act.
